Standard: Flight crew normal procedures and limits are reviewed to ensure they provide the flight crew with clear direction on using the VCF as intended by the design without introducing new hazards. Air vehicle limits are supported by the VCF design and analysis. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review flight manual to verify normal procedures and limits are clear and represent the state of the VCF development going into flight test. a. Air vehicle limits are supported by the VCF design and analysis. b. Key deficiencies are documented and presented to the flight crew and test team to characterize user impacts. c. Any workarounds for normal procedures and corresponding mitigations are documented and approved. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Examination.
(2) Review the flight manual to verify normal procedures and limits are clear and represent the state of the VCF design. a. Design changes and inputs from flight test are incorporated in the flight manual. b. Air vehicle limits are supported by the VCF design, analysis, and flight test. c. Key deficiencies are documented in the flight manual to characterize flight crew impacts.
